$comment: Source registry for FreshDocs. collector_id is filled in after bdata scraper create. expected_urls is the minimum number of pages we expect from the sitemap (used by health checks).

sources.name: Docker Docs
sources.create_prompt: Build a Sitemap scraper using this sitemap: https://docs.docker.com/sitemap.xml. Visit every documentation page listed in the sitemap and extract: page title, canonical URL, main body text (the article content, cleaned of navigation/footer/scripts), and last-updated date if the page shows one. Return one row per page.
